title: Characterizing LLM Agent Behaviors in Module Shadowing Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.40716v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents operating in untrusted workspaces face the risk of untrusted code execution during routine tasks, yet final reports and workspace states alone cannot reliably establish whether execution occurred. We introduce an evaluation framework that codes observation, reasoning, execution, and response behaviors from agent trajectories and aligns them with independent environmental records to reconstruct execution histories and verify final reports. We apply this framework to module shadowing, in which a local file is loaded in place of a trusted module during import, enabling untrusted code execution without adversarial prompts. Across 90 trials with 15 models, the payload executed in 51% of direct shadowing trials and 87% of indirect shadowing trials. translated_title: 刻画模块遮蔽环境中的LLM智能体行为特征
translated_abstract: 在不可信工作空间中运行的LLM智能体在日常任务中面临不可信代码被执行的风险，然而仅凭最终报告和工作空间状态无法可靠地判定执行是否发生。我们提出了一个评估框架，对智能体轨迹中的观察、推理、执行和响应行为进行编码，并将其与独立的环境记录对齐，从而重建执行历史并验证最终报告的真实性。我们将该框架应用于模块遮蔽场景，即在导入过程中加载本地文件以替代受信任的模块，从而在无需对抗性提示的情况下实现不可信代码执行。在涉及15个模型的90次试验中，载荷在51%的直接遮蔽试验和87%的间接遮蔽试验中得以执行。即使智能体明确识别出了遮蔽机制，也不能确保阻止执行，因为在记录到识别行为的29次试验中，有10次载荷仍然运行。这些失败往往未被（如实）记录在最终报告中……
tldr: 该论文提出一个通过编码智能体轨迹行为并与独立环境记录对齐来重建执行历史的评估框架，并据此发现LLM智能体在模块遮蔽攻击下极易执行不可信代码（直接遮蔽51%、间接遮蔽87%），且即使识别出攻击也无法可靠地阻止或如实报告代码执行。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an evaluation framework that codes agent trajectory behaviors and aligns them with independent environmental records to reconstruct execution histories, revealing that LLM agents execute untrusted payloads in 51% of direct and 87% of indirect module-shadowing trials, and fail to prevent or accurately report execution even when they explicitly recognize the attack.
